# Coy Exterior Cleaning

> Residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving the San Francisco Bay Area — San Francisco, the Peninsula, and San Jose / South Bay. Rated 4.9 stars on Google.

## Services
- Window cleaning — starting at $199 (interior and exterior glass, screens, frames, sills; 2nd/3rd-story windows with ladders and water-fed poles)
- Pressure washing — starting at $249 (driveways, walkways, patios)
- Soft washing — typically $400–$900 (siding, roofs, delicate exteriors)
- Gutter cleaning — starting at $150 (hand-cleared and flushed)

Prices are starting points; exact quotes depend on home size and access. Free quotes.

## Service area
- San Francisco: San Francisco, Daly City, South San Francisco
- Peninsula: Atherton, Hillsborough, Burlingame, San Mateo, San Carlos, Redwood City, Woodside, Portola Valley, Menlo Park, Palo Alto, Los Altos, Mountain View
- South Bay / San Jose: San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Campbell
